data.notes: Confirmed May 2027 inventory is still sparse and leans toward ticketed Israeli songbook and jazz concerts; major club/festival calendars for Tel Aviv do not appear to be announced yet.

events.title: Ani Ve'Ata – The Revolution Orchestra Plays Arik Einstein
events.venueName: Israeli Opera / Tel Aviv Performing Arts Center
events.summary: The Revolution Orchestra presents a new live interpretation of Arik Einstein’s Israeli pop/rock songbook, with guest actor Moni Moshonov and vocalist Roni Dalumi or Sivan Talmor listed by the presenter.

events.title: Yoni Rechter Solo +JAZZ
events.venueName: Sela Club, Charles Bronfman Culture Hall
events.summary: Yoni Rechter performs a solo piano-and-vocal show in the +JAZZ series, focused on his major songs and their connection to jazz language.

events.title: Hot Jazz 2026–2027: The Hermlins Band – Swing Is the Thing
events.summary: Berlin’s The Hermlins Band bring the Hot Jazz international series to Gray Tel Aviv with a swing program referencing Glenn Miller, Benny Goodman, Duke Ellington and Tommy Dorsey.
